tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Deep brand blue. Navbar ground in the light theme and headings on light grounds; text on `bg-app`, `bg-card` and `selected` in the light theme (do not use as text in the dark theme: use `text`).

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue sampled from the wordmark. Button fill, links and active controls in the light theme; carries white text (`on-primary`).

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Mid blue for hover states, chart series and focus accents. Never a fill behind text; 3:1 against white for graphics only.

tokens.name: teal-500
tokens.usage: Tagline teal. Active-nav underline, secondary highlights, chart accent. Never text on white (3.1:1): use `accent-ink` for teal text.

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows and the halftone dots on brand blue; text on it is `ink-900` or `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Body text colour in the light theme on `bg-app`, `bg-card`, `selected`.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Source secondary-text blue-grey, exact. 4.8:1 on white but 4.46:1 on `bg-app`, just under 4.5:1: for secondary text on `bg-app` use `text-muted`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white: card ground in the light theme and text on `brand-700` or `brand-900`.

tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Application background, cool and slightly blue. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, table rows, inputs. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`, `link`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and divider hairlines. Decorative only; a control edge uses `border-control`.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and dropzone edges; at least 3:1 on `bg-card` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `bg-app`, `bg-card` and `selected`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on `bg-card` and `bg-app`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (one per view). Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action hover fill. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label colour on `primary` and `primary-hover`. Dark in the dark theme because the fill is light.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and secondary-button labels on `bg-card` and `bg-app`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Teal used as text or an icon on `bg-card`, `bg-app` and `selected`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal accent for underlines, progress fills and chart series (3:1 against `nav` and `bg-card`).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active filter, hover tint behind `text`.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar ground. Text on it is `on-nav`; underline is `accent`.

tokens.name: on-nav
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `nav`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring with 2px offset; 3:1 on `bg-card`, `bg-app` and `nav`-adjacent surfaces. Use `on-nav` as the ring on the navbar itself.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and error text on `bg-card`; carries `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on `danger`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Inline error and invalid-field wash behind `danger` text.

tokens.name: status-submitted-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Submitted badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-submitted-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the Submitted badge on `status-submitted-bg`.

tokens.name: status-designing-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Designing badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-designing-fg

tokens.usage: Fill of the Design Done badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-design-done-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the Design Done badge on `status-design-done-bg`.

tokens.name: status-in-prepress-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the In Prepress badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-in-prepress-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the In Prepress badge on `status-in-prepress-bg`.

tokens.name: status-ready-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Ready for Delivery badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-ready-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the Ready for Delivery badge on `status-ready-bg`.

tokens.name: status-delivering-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Delivering badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-delivering-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the Delivering badge on `status-delivering-bg`.

tokens.name: status-completed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Completed badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.name: status-completed-fg
tokens.usage: Text and shape of the Completed badge on `status-completed-bg`.

tokens.name: status-on-hold-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the On Hold badge, stepper marker and timeline chip. Always shown with the text label and a shape, never alone.

tokens.usage: Text and shape of the On Hold badge on `status-on-hold-bg`.
